title: eval-harness: CI prompt-regression enhancements + metrics integration
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Improve CI prompt-regression hooks: add per-prompt quality gating, integrate eval metrics into CI dashboard, add lightweight CI image for faster runs. Backwards compatible; no user-facing API changes.
description: Motivation: Our current eval-harness CI hooks run full evals but lack per-prompt gating and tight integration with metrics dashboards. This causes noisy results and slow feedback for model rollouts. This PR introduces: - A new CI hook (ci/hooks/run_prompt_regression.sh) that runs a targeted prompt-set regression, computes per-prompt and aggregate metrics, and exits non-zero only when configured thresholds are violated. - Per-prompt quality gating: thresholds can be declared per-prompt-set in eval-harness/config/quality_gates.yml with a fallback global threshold. - Metrics integration: eval results are pushed to our CI Prometheus pushgateway and a lightweight JSON summary is emitted for CI artifacts to attach. - Faster CI: new Dockerfile(ci/images/eval-harness-ci.Dockerfile) builds a trimmed image with preinstalled model runtime dependencies to reduce cold-start time in CI. - Tests: added e2e and unit tests for gating logic and threshold parsing. This is a backwards-compatible change to the eval-harness CLI. Default behavior remains running the full eval if no gating config is present. Checklist: - [x] Add CI hook script and Docker image - [x] Implement per-prompt gating config parsing and enforcement - [x] Integrate push to Prometheus pushgateway + produce JSON artifact - [x] Add unit + e2e tests - [x] Update docs with usage and examples (docs/eval-harness/ci.md) Notes: Linear ENG-4123 tracks the follow-ups to add alerting rules based on the new metrics; QA-1021 covers additional stability tests. SUP-442 is a support ticket that motivated per-prompt thresholds for a customer-facing regression.
commits: Implement quality gate parsing and enforcement in eval-harness/ci/gates.py
Tests: tests/e2e/test_prompt_regression.py and unit tests for gates
